name: egemaps
title: eGeMAPS v02
description: The 88 functionals of the extended Geneva Minimalistic Acoustic Parameter Set (Eyben et al., 2016) for each clip, in the order of afx_audio.EGEMAPS_NAMES. Comparable with openSMILE's eGeMAPSv02 functionals; see docs/egemaps.md for the per-feature agreement.
